dateline: BTS closed three sold-out La Plata nights (Oct 21, 23, 24) of the ARIRANG World Tour; São Paulo is next on the Latin American leg.
heroHeadline: Day 4,883: BTS Turn to São Paulo After Argentina Debut
heroSubtitle: October 26, 2026 is Day 4,883 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. After three La Plata nights, the ARIRANG World Tour heads to São Paulo, with dates reported for October 28, 30 and 31; venue details are unconfirmed.
